item.title: CEO of the tech company behind Hinge and Tinder set up an employee hotline where staff can DM him anytime: ‘No hierarchy. No filters. Just real input.’
item.description: Spencer Rascoff, CEO of the tech company behind Hinge and Tinder, meets with Gen Z staffers monthly to leverage their “unfiltered perspective” thanks to the success of its employee hotline.

item.title: Block CEO Jack Dorsey lays off nearly half of his staff because of AI and predicts most companies will make similar cuts in the next year
item.description: The former Twitter CEO said AI was “enabling a new way of working” as his company scales back its workforce as a result of AI productivity gains.

item.title: Trump’s FTC backs off social media regulation despite finding that nearly 20% of America’s children are online for 4 hours or more
item.description: Kids are so addicted, their "compulsive unlocking" mirrors the biological clock of a smoker.

item.title: More people are moving out of the U.S. than moving in for the first time since the Great Depression—a bad omen for the $38.8 trillion national debt
item.description: How Trump’s immigration crackdown could erase “the most potent fiscal engine this country has ever seen.”

item.title: Before AI gains materialize, governments will have to deal with a ‘policy tradeoff,’ Moody’s says: How to handle the massive spending and debt risk
item.description: Countries might have to choose between taking on more short-term risk or missing out on future AI-driven growth.

item.title: The battle over WBD left three big winners on Wall Street—while the thousands who lost out will remain behind the scenes
item.description: In the eyes of investors, Netflix, Paramount, and WBD all won this Hollywood bidding war.

item.title: Have good taste? It may just get you a job during the AI jobs apocalypse, says Sam Altman
item.description: Tech insiders argue judgment and discernment could give humans an edge over AI.

item.title: Trump orders U.S. government to stop using Anthropic but gives Pentagon six months to phase it out while Hegseth adds supply-chain risk designation
item.description: Trump added that if Anthropic doesn’t obey, he will use “the Full Power of the Presidency to make them comply.”

item.title: Emil Michael, the Silicon Valley exec turned Trump official leading the war against Anthropic, has deep ties to the tech world
item.description: Michael, the Undersecretary of War, cut his teeth at Uber and has vowed not to bend to 'woke' AI.

item.title: Sam Altman tells staff at an all-hands that OpenAI is negotiating a deal with the Pentagon, after Trump orders the end of Anthropic contracts
item.description: The negotiations come as rival Anthropic is locked in a more contentious standoff with U.S. defense officials.
